settings.headline: Welcome to the staff portal
settings.body:
This area is for credentialed staff of the fictional Harlow Creek Health System. Use it for policy digests, onboarding checklists and quick clinical references.

It is a website account only. It is not the electronic health record, email or badge system.
settings.side: For electronic health record access, call the IT service desk at (555) 018-1400 (fictional).
